inputs.resume_text:
Ishaan Kulkarni
PGP 2025-27 | Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

EDUCATION
PGP, IIM Ahmedabad, 2025-27, CGPA 3.0/4.33
B.Tech, Chemical Engineering, IIT Bombay, 2021, 8.0/10

WORK EXPERIENCE (36 months)
Asian Paints, Ankleshwar plant | Production Engineer | Jul 2021 - Jun 2024
- Ran the emulsion section on rotating shifts with 35 operators; raised batch yield from 92.1% to 95.4%
- Led a Kaizen team that cut changeover time on the tinting line from 70 to 40 minutes
- Coordinated with the union committee during a 3-day contract-worker stoppage in 2023

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Aditya Birla Group, Group Executive Office | Strategy Intern | Apr - Jun 2026
- Evaluated 3 adjacencies for the group's chemicals business; recommended specialty adhesives, now under deeper study
- Built the business case for a 50 KTPA plant; IRR of 19% under base-case assumptions

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Secretary, Rural Immersion Program, IIM Ahmedabad: placed 80 students with 14 NGOs in Gujarat
- Head, Hostel Mess Committee, IIT Bombay (2019-20): managed a budget of INR 1.2 crore

EXTRACURRICULAR
- Completed the Ladakh Marathon (2023)

candidate.name: Ishaan
candidate.band_reason: The resume shows clear ownership, quantified outcomes, substantial operating scope and specific results across work, internship and leadership experiences.

concerns.detail: The resume shows a move from plant production engineering into strategy and general management through the MBA.

plan.warmup_question: What course or class discussion has occupied your attention recently?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career so far, from Asian Paints through your MBA and summer internship.

slots.core_question: Tell me how you evaluated the specialty-adhesives opportunity during your Aditya Birla Group internship.
slots.intent_private: Needs the decision framework Ishaan used to compare the three adjacencies, his personal analysis and recommendation, and what he took from the experience or would approach differently now.
likely_probes: Which part of the evaluation was your own analysis?
What did you decide against when making the recommendation?
What would you approach differently now?

slots.core_question: I see you raised batch yield at Asian Paints. What decisions drove that improvement?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific production problem, Ishaan's own decisions and actions while coordinating 35 operators, and how the change from 92.1% to 95.4% was measured.
likely_probes: Which decision was most directly yours?
What did you decide not to change?
What was the baseline for the 92.1% figure?

slots.core_question: How did the rural immersion placements come together at IIM Ahmedabad?
slots.intent_private: Needs the stakeholder plan Ishaan personally used to place 80 students with 14 NGOs, including how he handled competing needs and ensured the placements were completed.
likely_probes: What did you do first to organize the placements?
Which stakeholder decision was hardest for you?
How did you confirm that all 80 placements were completed?

slots.core_question: What was the hardest part of building the 50 KTPA business case?
slots.intent_private: Needs the assumptions Ishaan owned, the trade-off behind the 19% base-case IRR, the decision he made, and what he would do differently with more time.
likely_probes: Which assumption did you have the most influence over?
What alternative did you decide against?
What was the base case compared with?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes the strategy internship, plant operating impact and a distinctive IIM leadership experience, while covering business judgment, execution and stakeholder management. The resume also shows a transition from production engineering to general management through the MBA; this is noted for the interviewer, but back-your-resume slots are kept focused on evidence rather than adding a separate fit question.
